title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: In 2025, the ICSP programme supported communities in Harare and Matabeleland South to prepare for and respond to crises, reaching 163,205 people across all interventions. During the cholera and Mpox outbreaks, awareness activities reached 54,355 people in Harare and 17,625 in Matabeleland South, helping families recognise symptoms early and adopt protective behaviours. Partnerships with seven government departments strengthened district‑level coordination, enabling more organised preparedness and response actions. These efforts supported 26,238 people through DRR initiatives and helped communities activate early‑warning and contingency measures more effectively during climate‑related and public‑health emergencies.. Developing community-based early warning systems and preparedness & contingency plans for climate shocks and climate induced disasters (eg. flooding) to promote food security contingency plans. Strengthening national DRR systems for multi-sectoral response to climate shocks and hazards
